peptides.name: BPC-157
peptides.source: Synthetic — fragment of gastric juice protein (BPC)
peptides.mechanism: Upregulates growth hormone receptor, VEGF, promotes angiogenesis, stabilizes gut lining
peptides.half_life: <30 min (animal data only, never measured in humans)
peptides.timing: Morning and evening, split doses for injury protocols
peptides.human_trial: NO controlled trial exists. PubMed clinical-trial filter returns zero results. Three small uncontrolled case series from same group. One Phase 1 oral study.
peptides.fda: FDA stated no legal basis for compounding pharmacies to use it. Compounded forms banned.
peptides.red_flags: Zero clinical trial data. Enormous hype, negligible evidence. FDA ban on compounded forms.

peptides.name: TB-500
peptides.mechanism: Promotes cell migration, reduces inflammation, angiogenesis, wound healing via actin polymerization
peptides.human_trial: Minimal — mostly animal + equine (racehorse) data. Wound healing studies exist but small.
peptides.storage: Cold and dark; mixed vial 2-8C; use within 28 days
peptides.evidence_tier: LOW-MODERATE — equine data strong, human data thin
peptides.use_case: Injury recovery, muscle repair, wound healing, anti-inflammatory
peptides.red_flags: Racehorse drug. 72h spacing = protocol from animal PK. Human subQ PK unknown.

peptides.name: Ipamorelin
peptides.mechanism: Ghrelin mimetic — stimulates GH release without affecting cortisol, ACTH, or prolactin
peptides.timing: Fasted, before bed (natural GH peak timing)
peptides.human_trial: YES Phase II (Weaver 2008) — safe, well-tolerated, increased IGF-1
peptides.evidence_tier: MODERATE — Phase II data, clean mechanism, good safety
peptides.red_flags: Banned in competition. Long-term GH elevation risks unknown in healthy adults.

peptides.name: CJC-1295 w/DAC
peptides.source: Synthetic GHRH analog with Drug Affinity Complex (DAC)
peptides.mechanism: GHRH analog — stimulates GH release from pituitary. DAC prevents albumin binding degradation.
peptides.timing: Once weekly (DAC), or 1-2x daily without DAC
peptides.human_trial: YES Phase I (Teichman 2006) — dose-range study up to 60 mcg/kg best tolerated
peptides.evidence_tier: MODERATE — Phase I, long safety history in peptide community
peptides.red_flags: DAC = prolonged GH exposure → desensitization risk. Without DAC (Mod GRF) cleaner but shorter window.

peptides.name: Tesamorelin
peptides.source: Synthetic GHRH analog — modified human GHRH
peptides.mechanism: GHRH analog — stimulates natural GH production, reduces visceral adipose tissue
peptides.human_trial: YES Phase III — FDA-approved. 2 mg/day for HIV lipodystrophy.
peptides.side_effects: Injection site, arthralgia, peripheral edema, possible increased blood glucose

peptides.name: MOTS-c
peptides.mechanism: AMPK activation → glucose uptake, fat oxidation, mitochondrial biogenesis
peptides.timing: Training days AM or 30-60 min pre-session
peptides.human_trial: Minimal — mice studies + 1 small Korean human trial (glucose)
peptides.evidence_tier: LOW — mechanism solid, human data minimal
peptides.use_case: Metabolic flexibility, fat oxidation, insulin sensitivity
peptides.red_flags: WADA banned. Half-life unknown. Anti-anabolic trade-off at high doses (AMPK↑ → mTOR↓).

peptides.name: Semax
peptides.timing: Morning — activating, insomnia risk if late
peptides.human_trial: YES Multiple — Russian clinical studies (stroke, cognitive impairment, optic nerve disease). ClinicalTrials.gov: 0 registered trials.
peptides.evidence_tier: MODERATE-HIGH (Russia) — registered drug, multiple clinical studies
peptides.red_flags: All trials Russian. Zero Western registered trials. Intranasal route mandatory (matches trial data).

peptides.name: Selank
peptides.mechanism: GABA-A positive allosteric modulation, BDNF upregulation, IL-6/TNF-alpha regulation
peptides.human_trial: YES Multiple — Russian clinical studies (anxiety, neurasthenia)
peptides.side_effects: Minimal. No sedation, no tolerance, no withdrawal.
peptides.red_flags: Russian framework only. GABA mechanism — stack carefully with alcohol/benzos.

peptides.name: Epithalon
peptides.source: Synthetic tetrapeptide — pineal gland peptide analog
peptides.dose_starter: 0.5 mg/day x 20 days (only human dose studied)
peptides.evidence_tier: LOW — one pilot, community doses 10-20x extrapolation
peptides.red_flags: Community protocol far exceeds only studied human dose.

peptides.name: GHK-Cu
peptides.mechanism: Copper delivery, collagen/elastin stimulation, wound healing, gene expression
peptides.human_trial: YES — topical wound healing studies. SubQ = community convention.
peptides.side_effects: Injection STING (worst of all peptides), skin tightness

peptides.name: PT-141
peptides.mechanism: MC4R agonist — sexual desire pathway in brain
peptides.dose_starter: 0.5 mg (tolerance test only — zero efficacy data below 0.75mg)
peptides.human_trial: YES Phase III — FDA-approved as Vyleesi
peptides.red_flags: Nausea very common. No efficacy data below 0.75mg.

peptides.name: AOD-9604
peptides.source: Synthetic fragment of human growth hormone
peptides.mechanism: Fat metabolism stimulation without IGF-1 elevation
peptides.human_trial: One small trial. No dose-finding study.

peptides.name: SS-31
peptides.mechanism: Cardiolipin stabilization → oxidative phosphorylation, ROS reduction
peptides.cycle: Continuous — judge at 6 months not 6 weeks
peptides.human_trial: YES Phase II — heart failure, Barth syndrome, dry AMD

peptides.name: Thymalin
peptides.human_trial: YES — Russian clinical studies, immune restoration in elderly

stacks.name: Recovery
stacks.notes: BPC-157 FDA-banned for compounding. 4-6 week cycle.

stacks.name: GH Optimization
stacks.notes: Monitor IGF-1 quarterly. Avoid with cancer history.

stacks.name: Cognitive + Calm
stacks.notes: Both nasal preferred (matches trials). 2-4 week cycles.

stacks.name: Longevity
stacks.notes: Epithalon annual pulse. SS-31 continuous. Expensive.
